type: reflection-driven: per-type field descriptors (igMetaField-style: field offset + is-pointer + array-count) walked per object, NOT a flat stored offset list
structure: The pointer relocation is computed at load from per-type field metadata, not read from a flat table

location.offset: unknown; not stored as raw offsets, cumulative sums, a bitmap, or a byte/u16 delta stream in sections 0,2-8

meaning: Static probe (igz relocation-probe) result: the 162 110 relocated section-1 words are reproduced by NO flat encoding — not raw offsets, cumulative deltas, LEB128, byte/u16 delta streams, nor a bitmap, in any of sections 0,2-8 (best recall < 2%); there is no named fixup section (no ROFS/RVTB/etc. magic; sections end exactly at EOF). Instead a structural model explains 76.2% directly (29.2% at type-consistent fixed field offsets, 47.1% inside contiguous pointer arrays whose length varies per instance) and the remainder are per-instance pointers in variable-layout records. This is the signature of REFLECTION-DRIVEN relocation: each type carries field descriptors (offset, is-pointer, and for list fields a count to follow), and the loader walks every processed object`s fields by its type to rebase them (Alchemy igMetaObject/igMetaField). Consequences for M3, reframed: there is NO flat relocation list to decode and extend; a clone of an EXISTING type needs no new relocation data — it only needs to be PROCESSED by the same per-type field walk as the originals, which is gated on being a first-class record (a header-table entry). The remaining task is therefore (a) locate the per-type field descriptors in the section-0 metadata to model relocation to 100% and, (b) register the clone without the global-shift desync that broke the header-table growth attempt (m3-…-1789258792820). Tooling: `igz relocation-probe <decoded> --fixups <map>` scores encoding hypotheses and the structural model on every section.

evidence.summary: clone inside span, no table entry: clone owner constructed (vtable) but its field pointers NOT rebased (owner+0x3c stays 0x40c49c), physics child never built -> hang
clone inside span WITH a table entry (32-byte global shift): relocation desynced globally, only 1 036 records constructed, header type words wrongly rebased (physics +0 0x7b -> base+0x7b), early hang
no flat/bitmap decoder exceeds 2% recall on any section; structural model (type fixed fields + array runs) explains 76.2%; no fixup-section magic; file ends at the last section
